text: That is where the lamp fitters kept their lunch. The lunch is still there. I would leave it.
That is the fan room. The fan was never delivered. The stream has run without one for years, and I have decided not to ask how.
That is the decorators' store. They primed one wall, billed me for nine, and left through the tenth.
You have found a storeroom. It held crates one to six. It does not hold them now, and nobody signed them out.
Come out of the wall. I had a point to make about that sentry, and I refuse to make it to a doorway.
You came all the way back for a cupboard. The examination is in the other direction. It has always been in the other direction.
